summary: As Iowa State Auditor in December 2019, Sand enforced the state's anti-boycott law, urging compliance with disclosure requirements, and called Israel 'a great ally to us.' In October 2023, he posted in agreement with Iowa Democrats condemning the Hamas attacks, writing 'a day of great horror. Praying for all.' Both documented actions align with a pro-Israel posture and offer no recorded counterweight on Palestinian justice.
